name: Suitcase Carry

instructions.description: Hold a kettlebell in one hand beside the body.
Stand tall without leaning and begin walking.
Take controlled steps while keeping the shoulders level.
Set the load down safely, then repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record distance completed while maintaining the intended movement quality.
Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

variations.variationDescription: Suitcase Carry — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Suitcase Carry — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Avoid leaning toward or away from the load.
